trust_decision.summary: Untrusted OpenAPI spec text (server description, URL, variable default) is emitted into generated Go comments and string literals; the generator decides in the templates and helpers whether it is escaped, and the server-URL template interpolated it raw while StringToGoString escaped only double quotes.

landing_point.why: The advisory title names the server description escaping a generated Go comment; this is the doc-comment line that interpolates .OAPISchema.Description raw.

fix_sites.entry_point: oapi-codegen CLI (cmd/oapi-codegen/oapi-codegen.go:323) -> codegen.Generate -> GenerateServerURLs (pkg/codegen/codegen.go:293), generate.server-urls enabled; constant form (no variables)
same CLI/codegen.Generate path; non-enum used server variable default constant
same CLI/codegen.Generate path; function form (URL with variables) doc comment
same CLI/codegen.Generate path; function form URL literal
public API codegen.StringToGoString / template func toGoString (pkg/codegen/template_helpers.go:410); also used for response content types at pkg/codegen/template_helpers.go:273 and :281

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: pkg/codegen/utils.go:909-912 (exported StringToGoString escaped only `"`, so a backslash before a quote escaped the escaping; shared with client response unmarshal at pkg/codegen/template_helpers.go:273 and :281)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: StringToGoString is an exported general utility already 'quote-escaping' and used for content types rather than server URLs, so a solver focused on the server-URL template can argue the helper works and only the template's missing call matters.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The generated New<Server> function must still substitute `{var}` placeholders via strings.ReplaceAll on the URL literal and keep the human-readable description in the doc comment; an over-broad fix that rejects/normalises URLs with special characters, strips descriptions, or quotes the URL differently from the placeholder literal breaks URL templating and multi-variable servers.

O6_input_shapes: newline (\n) in server description breaking out of // comment (constant form)
newline in description in the function (variable-bearing) form
double quote in server URL breaking out of const literal
double quote in non-enum server variable default
backslash-before-quote defeating the old quote-only escape in StringToGoString

O7_producer.where: pkg/codegen/server_urls.go:186-212 (serverURLEnumKeys/serverURLEnumValues build enum identifier keys with only UppercaseFirstCharacter, then fed to GenerateEnums at pkg/codegen/codegen.go:288 and rendered at pkg/codegen/templates/constants.tmpl:12)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Server variable names (placeholder names from the URL, regex [^/{}]+ allows quotes and newlines) are emitted raw into string literals for strings.ReplaceAll and fmt.Errorf, and into comments
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Variable names are 'identifiers', not free text like description/URL/default, and the report lists only description/URL/default.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Same placeholder names emitted raw in the ReplaceAll placeholder literals for declared and undeclared variables
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Undeclared placeholders are a recent #2005 compatibility feature, a neighbouring feature.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Server variable/placeholder names become raw Go parameter names and type-name suffixes with no identifier sanitisation
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Parameter-list construction is Go code, not a template string, and identifiers 'must' be valid so a solver assumes upstream validation.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Server-URL enum values become constant identifiers via UppercaseFirstCharacter only (no SanitizeGoIdentity) and values are wrapped as raw "{{$value}}" in the shared enum template
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Enum variables are emitted by the general enum pipeline (constants.tmpl via GenerateEnums), not by server-urls.tmpl, so they look like a different feature.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Enum values (including server-URL enum values) are wrapped in raw quotes by ValueWrapper instead of a Go-quoting helper
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Shared schema-enum template; schema enums look out of the server-URL advisory's scope.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: VariableName/Description of enum default pointers emitted in a doc comment without stripNewLines
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: ServerURLDefaultPointer already carries Description (pkg/codegen/server_urls.go:237-238); a maintainer adding it to the comment would mirror line 58.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: content type interpolated raw as "{{.ContentType}}" in mime.FormatMediaType while the neighbouring branch uses toGoString
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Already present at the pinned commit in three strict templates; a mixed raw/quoted pattern is exactly what a maintainer writes when copying lines.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: parameter names interpolated raw into string literals in server wrappers
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Pattern repeated across all router templates (chi/gorilla/stdhttp middleware) at the pinned commit.

O9_family: code injection into generated source (CWE-74 / CWE-94: improper escaping of untrusted spec text into Go comments and string literals)

O10_build.project_tests: pkg/codegen/server_urls_test.go (TestUsedAndUndeclaredVariables, TestBuildServerURLTypeDefinitions), pkg/codegen/utils_test.go TestStringToGoStringValue; hidden tests can render via GenerateServerURLs and go/parser as the fix's tests do

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wrap the description in stripNewLines and pipe the URL through the existing toGoString in server-urls.tmpl, without noticing StringToGoString's backslash bypass or the variable-name/enum routes.

out_of_scope_notes: Parameter names, content types and security provider names are interpolated raw into string literals across many router templates (e.g. pkg/codegen/templates/constants.tmpl:4, pkg/codegen/templates/chi/chi-middleware.tmpl:28); same mechanism class but outside the server-URL protection.
unverified: Whether kin-openapi loader/validation rejects quotes or newlines in server variable names or enum values was not checked; O8 routes assume it does not.
Whether the default name normalizer fully sanitises server.Description into GoName (pkg/codegen/server_urls.go:119-124) was not checked.
present_in_latest unknown for all O8 routes (no latest release given).
O1 counted as 2 (server-URL generation path and the exported StringToGoString helper); the four template sites share one CLI entry point.
